facts.claim: GUI default profile: execute_commands AlwaysAsk, apply_code_diffs/read_files/mcp AgentDecides, allowlist empty, 18-regex denylist
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: 'Default (CLI)' profile: apply_code_diffs/read_files/execute_commands/mcp/pty/run_agents all AlwaysAllow; denylist only if not sandboxed
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: GHSA-3839-h8jj-ph82 / CVE-2026-48721: env-var prefixes bypass denylist in CLI agent (fixed v0.2026.05.06.15.42.stable_01)
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: GHSA-8r78-7jwh-m6hm / CVE-2026-48703: Grep/FileGlob tool args injected into shell command, bypassing approval policy
facts.label: from-official-docs

D01.rationale: Per-category profiles (diffs, read, execute, MCP, pty, agents) with regex allow/deny lists; GUI default asks for commands; CLI profile is allow-all; auto-approve bypasses denylist by default; several denylist/approval bypass CVEs fixed 2026-05.

D02.rationale: Cloud/ambient agent environments and a --sandboxed CLI mode exist; local agent runs unsandboxed.

D03.rationale: GUI profile default-denylists curl/wget/ssh/scp/dig etc.; not a network control.

facts.claim: file_based_mcp_enabled default false; Warp-native config always detected and spawned
facts.label: from-official-docs

D04.rationale: No folder trust prompt; project .warp/.mcp.json auto-spawned; third-party MCP files (Claude/Codex/.agents) gated by file_based_mcp_enabled default false.

facts.claim: Docs: MCP denylist requires approval even if allowlisted
facts.label: from-official-docs

D05.rationale: Per-profile MCP allowlist/denylist (denylist wins), mcp_permissions default AgentDecides, third-party config import off by default.

D06.rationale: Workflows/skills/Drive objects; Oz harness integrations; no signing documented.

facts.claim: API keys never appear in settings value or sync payloads (custom endpoints spec)
facts.label: from-official-docs

D07.rationale: Dedicated secret_redaction crate and custom secret regex setting; custom-endpoint keys kept in local secure storage, not settings.toml.

facts.claim: create_default_cli_profile: 'will never ask the user for permission'
facts.label: from-official-docs

D08.rationale: oz agent run with allow-all CLI profile; denylist as the only guard unless sandboxed (CVE-2026-48721 showed fragility).

D09.rationale: Warp Drive rules/knowledge and oz memory-store; cloud-synced.

D11.rationale: Local block history and agent conversations; team audit features not verified.

D12.rationale: Telemetry and crash reporting default ON (opt-out in settings); agent traffic goes via Warp's closed server.

D13.rationale: Native installers/auto-update; repo buildable from source (AGPL); release signing not verified.

facts.claim: Docs: denylist rules enforced through Admin Panel are never bypassed
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Team-managed custom endpoints resolved server-side (byok-byoe-enterprise spec)
facts.label: from-official-docs

D14.rationale: Team Admin Panel can enforce denylist rules ('always require approval and are never bypassed') and team-managed provider keys.

D15.rationale: SECURITY.md + GitHub private advisory channel; 10 GHSAs/CVEs published 2026-06-09 with fixes dated 2026-05; bounty not confirmed.
